operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Generic, metadata-driven listing endpoint for the v2 API. It returns a **paginated, filtered, sorted** list of records for any supported entity, using a single consistent query grammar.

`GET /v2/api/entity/{entity}/list/{level}`

- **`{entity}`** — the entity key to list (e.g. `invoice`, `client`, `product`). The endpoint works for every listable entity; the enum on the `entity` path parameter is a representative sample, not the complete set.
- **`{level}`** — the *data-detail level*: how deeply related records are loaded. It is **not** a page number. Higher levels return more nested relations.

  | Level | What is returned |
  |---|---|
  | -1 | Base record fields only, no related records |
  | 0 | Own fields + one-to-one related records |
  | 1 | Own fields + one-to-one + belongs-to + one-to-many (one level deep) |
  | 2 | Same as level 1 plus one extra level of nested relations (default) |
  | 3 | Even deeper nesting |

## Pagination

Paging is controlled by the `page` and `per_page` query parameters, **not** by the URL. The response is a standard paginated envelope (`data` array + `current_page`, `per_page`, `total`, `last_page`, page-URL fields).

## Filtering

Filters use bracket syntax: `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>`. Combine conditions with `filter[and][...]` and `filter[or][...]` groups. See the `filter[<field>][<operator>]` parameter for the full list of operators.

## Sorting

Sort with `sort[<field>]=<direction>`, where direction is `asc` or `desc`. Multiple sort keys are applied in order, e.g. `sort[created]=desc&sort[id]=asc`.

## Field selection

Restrict the returned columns with `fields[]=<column>` (repeat for each column). When omitted, all fields for the requested level are returned.

## Authentication

Send an OAuth Bearer access token in the `Authorization` header.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity key to list. The listed values are a representative sample — the endpoint supports every listable entity (core and custom).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description:
Response shape / listing mode. Defaults to `api` when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| api | Paginated API response (default). Rows are reshaped so related records are nested objects. |
| listing | Paginated response used by the web UI listing (v2 formatting). |
| count | Returns only the total count of matching records. |
| export | Returns data prepared for export. |
| nav | Navigation mode; used with `current_id` to fetch neighbouring records. |

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to `20`.

parameters.name: fields[]
parameters.description: Restrict the returned columns. Repeat for each column, e.g. `fields[]=id&fields[]=no`. When omitted, all fields for the requested level are returned.

parameters.name: sort[<field>]
parameters.description: Sort the results. Use `sort[<field>]=<direction>` where direction is `asc` or `desc`. Repeat for multiple keys; they are applied in the given order, e.g. `sort[created]=desc&sort[id]=asc`. When omitted, a saved sorting preference or the primary key is used.

parameters.name: filter[<field>][<operator>]
parameters.description:
Filter the results. Repeat the parameter for each condition.

**Syntax:** `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` (omitting the operator is equivalent to `equal`).

**Operators**

| Operator | Meaning |
|---|---|
| equal | Equals (`=`) — the default when no operator is given |
| not_equal | Not equal (`!=`) |
| gt | Greater than (`>`) |
| lt | Less than (`<`) |
| gte / from | Greater than or equal (`>=`) |
| lte / to | Less than or equal (`<=`) |
| like | Contains (`LIKE %value%`) |
| in | In a list of values |
| not_in | Not in a list of values |
| is_null | Field is null |
| is_not_null | Field is not null |

Only the operators above are recognized; any other keyword is treated as `equal`. Express a range with two conditions (`filter[amount][from]=10&filter[amount][to]=99`); there is no `between` operator.

**AND / OR groups**

Wrap conditions in `filter[and][...]` or `filter[or][...]` to group them. The OR group is the usual way to run a keyword search across several fields, e.g. `filter[or][no][like]=INV&filter[or][client_business_name][like]=INV`.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to `2` to return records formatted with the v2 field formatters.

parameters.name: image_size
parameters.description: Requested image size for record images. Only applies when `version=2`.

parameters.name: request_branch_id
parameters.description: Scope the results to a specific branch by its ID.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language. Accepts `ar` or `en`. The `Accept-Language` header is also honoured.

data.description: The matching records. Each row carries the entity's own fields at the top level plus nested objects for its related records (depth depends on `{level}`). The exact fields depend on the requested entity.

from.description: Index of the first record on this page (null when empty).

next_page_url.description: URL of the next page (null on the last page).

prev_page_url.description: URL of the previous page (null on the first page).

to.description: Index of the last record on this page (null when empty).

400.description: The entity does not exist, its plugin is not active, or the entity is not listable. Example messages: `Entity Not exists`, `Plugin not active`.

401.description: The access token is missing/invalid, or the account lacks permission to view this entity. Example message: `You are not allowed to view this page`.
